description: Na₆WP₄ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃mc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four P atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.88-2.94 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one W and five P atoms. The Na-W bond length is 3.24 Å. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.95-3.18 Å. W is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to three equivalent Na and four P atoms. There is one shorter (2.30 Å) and three longer (2.31 Å) W-P bond lengths. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven Na and one W atom. In the second P site, P is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one W atom.
